description: Transform your project workflows with Acterys Gantt, a powerful Gantt chart visual for Power BI designed for seamless project management in Power BI. This feature-rich, interactive tool lets you plan, monitor, and update tasks directly within Power BI—eliminating the need for external tools and boosting productivity. Acterys Gantt supports real-time task edits, drag-and-drop Gantt chart functionality in Power BI, hierarchical task tracking, and resource management in Power BI, making it the go-to solution for project and operations teams. Whether you're visualizing deadlines or aligning resources, Acterys Gantt helps you manage projects more efficiently—all within your Power BI reports. Acterys delivers leading planning and analytics tools that empower organizations to manage complex projects with agility, clarity, and control. Key Features: Interactive Task Updates: Edit task details using drag-and-drop directly inside the visual Use input forms for detailed task information and updates Resource Assignment: Assign and manage project resources within the Power BI Gantt chart for optimized planning Hierarchical Task Display: Visualize tasks across multiple levels with nesting and structured grouping Progress Tracking: Monitor and update task completion status in real time Flexible Data Integration: Connects to any Acterys-supported source, including ERP, CRM, and accounting…
